messages:
Alex: Heads up — seeing a spike in evictions in us-west2-a starting ~06:12 UTC. Pattern: lots of tiny GPU pods filling small leftover slots, big long-running jobs stuck pending, then node OOMs and kubelet restarts. Network jitter to control-plane also observed.

Maria: Yep, I noticed a couple of big model-serving pods pending and a flurry of 0.25/0.5 GPU jobs landing on odd nodes. Autoscaler spun up 6 nodes but packer left them fragmented. :eyes:

Derek: Quick logs:
```
I0331 06:12:44.123 kubelet.go:197] Evicting pod default/train-xyz due to nodefs.available < threshold
W0331 06:12:44.130 scheduler_pred: insufficient resources: requested 1g, available 0.5g
E0331 06:12:45.004 kubelet: heartbeat timeout: 9s
```

Judy: Scheduler shows a preemption/pack loop. We preempt tiny pods to make room, but preempted pods immediately reschedule to other fragmented nodes -> churn. See scheduler log snippet: `pack: score delta -0.47, prefer_small=true, preempt_candidate=train-xyz`.

SchedulerBot: Rebalancer kicked: defrag-run=3, nodes-drained=4, policy=soft-affinity, fallbacks=enabled.

Alex: Immediate mitigations we should apply now:
- pause scale-up for us-west2 for 10m to stop burst provisioning
- disable aggressive soft-affinity fallback in the hot zone
- cordon a couple of noisy nodes for manual compaction
- increase kubelet heartbeat threshold from 5s -> 15s while network heals

Maria: Agree. Also we should empty warm-pool tiny pods into a temporary bin to allow packing consolidation. We can script: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --pod-selector='size=small'` on targets.

Derek: Quick patch to scheduler config that helped in staging:
```
packing:
  prefer_balance_across_az: true
  group_by_gpu_topology: true
  small_pod_soft_limit: 0.12 # fraction, avoid spilling small pods across nodes
  preempt_backoff_ms: 12000
```
This reduced spillback and preempt churn in tests.

ops: Cost note — we saw ~72 GPU-hours of extra churn in the last 12h, ~\u00241.2k before autoscaler rightsized. If this continues across the cluster, weekly could hit ~\u002418k extra. Need to track and alert.

Judy: Long term fixes proposed:
- canonical slot sizing (uniform GPU slot profiles per node type) so tiny pods don't carve odd leftovers
- packer change: prefer filling by GPU-compute bins, then by AZ proximity
- improve network-path monitoring between kubelets and control-plane to avoid false heartbeat evictions
- add an eviction-telemetry gauge so we can correlate churn -> cost automatically

Alex: I'll own the immediate playbook actions. Maria, can you run the drain script on two candidate nodes and post outputs here? Derek, can you open a scheduler config PR with the staging values? I'll coordinate with SRE to bump the heartbeat threshold.

Maria: On it, starting drain now. Will paste short logs when done.

Derek: PR opened: https://git.redwood/sched/patches/456 — includes tests and a canary rollout plan.

SchedulerBot: Canary rollout started: 2% of clusters, monitor token: defrag.alerts.

Alex: Thanks team. Keep updates brief here — post follow-ups to the incident doc if anything escalates.
